_comment: Hand-maintained enrichment for the evidence registry. Host rules apply to a whole publisher; url rules apply to a URL prefix and win over host rules; record rules are keyed by evidenceId and win over both. isLiveDataset is curated rather than inferred because it is a judgement about a product, not a property of a URL, and guessing it permissively would present a moving number as a fixed one.

gml.noaa.gov.notes: Global Monitoring Laboratory trend series; values are revised as the record extends.

ncei.noaa.gov.notes: Global temperature and State of the Climate products are reissued monthly and annually.

sealevel.nasa.gov.notes: Altimeter record; the cumulative rise and the rate both move with each release.

nsidc.org.notes: Sea-ice extent and related cryosphere indices.

climate.copernicus.eu.notes: C3S monthly and annual climate bulletins.

globalcarbonproject.org.notes: The global carbon budget is reissued yearly and prior years are revised.

iucnredlist.org.notes: Assessment counts change with each update.

gbif.org.notes: Occurrence and taxon counts grow continuously.

nobelprize.org.notes: Cited as a dated record of what was recognised and when, not as a scientific source.

verra.org.notes: Commercial carbon-standards body. Cited only for the content of its own protocols, never as scientific authority.

wwf.org.uk.notes: Publisher of record for the Living Planet Index; cited for the index's own method and figures.

staatsbosbeheer.nl.notes: Netherlands state forestry service; primary record for Dutch reserve-management case material.

https://science.nasa.gov/climate-change.notes: NASA vital-signs figures update with each release; the rest of science.nasa.gov is static explainer material.

https://www.eia.gov/todayinenergy.notes: Dated article; the figures in it are fixed at publication.

https://www.nlr.gov/pv/cell-efficiency.notes: Best research-cell efficiency chart; champion values change.

https://www.iea.org/.notes: Site root; individual dated reports are stable editions.
